programme.title: Найди свой путь. Не устраивает жизнь. Что делать?
programme.desc: Меня не устраивает моя жизнь – так рано или поздно думает каждый человек. Такие мысли часто сопровождаются чувством, будто ты упал в жизненную яму и не знаешь, как из нее выбраться. Что делать в этом случае? Гость программы рассказывает свою историю о том, как он, раз за разом обращаясь к Богу за помощью, получал помощь и направление в решении проблемы, выстраивал живые отношения с Ним. programme.title: Возрождение. Верность Иисусу Христу
programme.desc: Иисус Христос обещал прийти на землю в второй раз. Библия призывает нас быть готовыми к Его Второму Пришествию. Как готовиться к этому событию? Как не терять веру в это: ведь время идет, а Христос не приходит, хотя и обещал это 2000 лет назад. Почему Он медлит? Истории из Ветхого Завета показывают нам, какую жизнь Бог готовит для нас и чего Он от нас ожидает. Бог хочет, чтобы мы проявляли верность Ему. Ведущий: Вячеслав Бучнев, священнослужитель

programme.title: В гостях у ТРК «Три Ангела». Разворот на 180: от атеизма к вере
programme.desc: Человек становится верующим. Три слова, но за ними стоит большая работа Бога над сердцем этого человека, молитвы окружающих и непростая внутренняя работа самого человека. Человек становится верующим, и это всегда неизбежно влечет изменение его жизни, от пищевых привычек до вечной участи. Анвар Гиндуллин рассказывает свою историю о том, как, будучи выходцем из атеистической семьи, стал священнослужителем. Ведущий: Анна Богатская, Гость: Анвар Гиндуллин, священнослужитель

programme.title: Мастерская добрых дел. Пирожки прощения или Пир на весь двор (История о Закхее) / Когда в дом приходит Небо
programme.desc: Кода в дом приходит Небо в лице Иисуса Христа, меняется вся жизнь живущих в этом доме. На своем опыте познал это и мытарь Закхей, историю о котором рассказал дядя Афанасий. Однажды жадный до денег мытарь, услышав о том, что в город пришел Иисус, захотел увидеть Его и добился своего. Но Христос пошел дальше: Он вошел в дом сборщика податей и гостил у него. Господь помог избавиться ему от жадности. А у вас есть какие-нибудь качества, от которых вы хотите избавиться? Обратитесь за помощью к Иисусу и пригласите Его в свой дом, и Он поможет вам. Ведущий: Михаил Севастьянов, Ольга Макарова, Гость: Маша Симакова, Сережа Ивенин, Петя Ягодкин

programme.title: Слово на сей час. Всё могу во Христе
programme.desc: «Всё могу в укрепляющем меня Иисусе Христе», – написал однажды апостол Павел. Многие верующие ему вторят, но почему-то успеха в христианской жизни так и не имеют. Что значит эта фраза? Что действительно может делать искренний христианин, а чего он не может? Идет ли в тексте речь о каких-то сверхъестественных способностях? И как обстоят дела с чтением Библии, молитвой, посещение церкви, добрыми делами – даёт ли Бог силу для этого? Ведущий: Виталий Киссер, священнослужитель

Сегодня многие говорят, что закон Божий был дан для евреев, а для людей, живущих в современном обществе, он потерял актуальность. Так ли это на самом деле? Об этих симпатичных божьих созданиях мы расскажем в нашей программе. Ведущий: Ольга Феофанова, Гость: Дарья Хасанова, магистр биологии

programme.title: Библия. Лютер и Библия
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». Протестантская Реформация в 2017 году отметила свой 500-летний юбилей. Мартин Лютер, с именем которого неразрывно связано это историческое событие, перевел Библию на немецкий язык и дал право толковать Священное Писание каждому человеку. Какие принципы Реформации провозгласил Лютер? Кто в истории России первым перевел Библию на родной язык и тем самым внес большой вклад в духовное развитие страны? Ведущий: Иван Лобанов, ведущий научный сотрудник Института перевода Библии им. М. П.Кулакова, Гость: А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Ю. Друми, доктор богословия, Н. Шабуров, профессор, директор Центра Изучения Религий РГГУ, о. игумен Иннокентий (Павлов), кандидат богословия, член правления РБО, С. Ряховский, Начальствующий Епископ Российского объединенного союза христиан веры евангельской, член Совета по взаимодействию с религиозными объединениями при Президенте РФ, Н. Гузов

Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second – and often surprising – decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. programme.title: 45 Minuten Thüringen
programme.desc: In einer Koproduktion der lokalen TV-Sender in Thüringen bringt Moderator Mike Langer Politik ganz nah an die Menschen. In jeder Folge trifft er auf Politikakteure oder -beobachter aus dem Freistaat Thüringen und beleuchtet nicht nur die politischen Themen der Region, sondern auch die Persönlichkeiten hinter den Entscheidungen.Was bewegt die Menschen, die über Thüringens Zukunft entscheiden? Welche Geschichten und Erfahrungen prägen ihre Arbeit? ?45 Minuten Thüringen? liefert unterhaltsame und tiefgründige Einblicke in den politischen Alltag und zeigt dabei mitunter auch eine andere Seite der Politik. Freuen Sie sich auf offene Gespräche, aktuelle Analysen und persönliche Anekdoten ? für alle, die Thüringen und seine Macher besser verstehen wollen.

programme.title: Dòtaman

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts a quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the ‘Pretenders’, who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants. Which of this week’s teams, Rona & Màiri or Seoras & Sean, will get the upper hand and have a chance to take home the grand prize? Niall Iain Dòmhnallach le farpais cheist ùr far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Tha na Mas Fhìoraich a’ gabhail pàirt bhon dachaighean ’s ag amas air a’ chùis a dhèanamh air an dà sgioba. Cò aca bho sgiobaidhean na seachdain-sa, Rona & Màiri no Seoras & Sean, a gheibh làmh an uachdar agus cothrom fhaighinn air an duais mhòr?

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara/Mermaid Tales

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s to the 1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online, and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Transatlantic Sessions
programme.desc: Julie Fowlis agus Muireann Nic Amhlaoibh le taghadh ciùil bho Transatlantic Sessions. Julie Fowlis and Muireann Nic Amhlaoibh present highlights from Transatlantic Sessions.

programme.title: An t-Eilean/The Island
programme.desc: When Lady Mary Maclean is murdered on the Isle of Harris, newly qualified family liaison officer PC Kat Crichton is assigned to the case. A high-profile case like this is the career opportunity of a lifetime but for Kat, this is not just a job. A decade earlier, she got caught up in the twisted web of the Maclean family and was forced to flee the island. Ten years older, a resolute Kat now returns, determined to bring the killer to justice. Nuair a tha Lady Mary NicIllEathain air a murt sna Hearadh, tha an t-Oifigear Teaghlaich ùr, PC Kat Crichton, a’ tòiseachadh air a’ chùis. Cha ghabh cùis le ìomhaigh cho àrd ri seo a sheachnadh ach do Kat, chan e obair a-mhàin a tha seo. Deich bliadhna roimhe, chaidh a glacadh ann an lìon toinnte teaghlach MhicIllEathain agus b’ fheudar dhi an t-eilean fhàgail. Tha Kat a’ tilleadh, nas sine, dàna agus daingeann gum faigh ceartas làmh an uachdair air a’ mhurtair. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha an Dutch Baby annasach ach anabarrach blasta. Brunch sònraichte air nach dìochuimhnich thu a’ chiad ghreis. The unusual but extremely delicious Dutch baby is a special brunch that you won't forget in a hurry. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ feuchainn air biadh à Iapan an-diugh. Tha Ruaraidh a’ dèanamh Wagyu Sukiyaki agus Bradan Teriyaki cuide ri Pak Choi agus nudailean. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh Coiridh Katsu ann an cruth biadh bhon taobh an iar agus an uairsin stèig Wagyu le glasraich uaine Oirthireach agus sliseagan ruis. The lads are inspired to cook Japanese dishes. Roddy creates a wagyu sukiyaki and a salmon teriyaki accompanied by pak choi and noodles. Uisdean rustles up a western-style katsu curry from scratch then cooks a waygu steak with oriental greens and rice chips. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Ann Droid
programme.desc: Sue wishes she could see the Leonids meteor storm one last time in her life under clear skies, so Linda persuades her to go camping. But Linda inadvertently causes chaos at the campsite, and things get worse when they decide to go for a walk to get away from their fellow campers. Meanwhile, Michael gets some life-changing news.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: George Anderson and Brian Cunningham delve into the mailbox to tackle a host of viewers’ questions sent in from around the country. Even though we are well into the growing season, the pair start a major new project as they launch a makeover of a Beechgrove area known as the Crooked Garden. One of the first parts of that revamp is the creation of a stumpery, a growing technique based on an old tree and planted with a range of ferns. George has details on how to feed a cherry tree, Brian is back in the 8x6 greenhouse, and there is a visit to St Andrews Botanic Garden.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Blackadder or The Young Ones? Beef or Chicken? Today’s teams will need to stay sharp and trust their instincts as Jason Manford hosts the quiz where questions have just two possible answers.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The team revive a cherished rocking horse, a spectacular set of conga drums, and a logbook that played a key role in British LGBTQ+ history.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Nina Conti, Nick Helm, Athena Kugblenu and Toby Tarrant take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games kitchen composter, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The competition kicks off in Belfast as Vernon Kay and unreliable tour guide Paul Gorton serve up facts, fibs and playful distractions as the celebrity players attempt to sort truth from twaddle. This week’s guests are presenter Owain Wyn Evans, Olympic champion Greg Rutherford and Blue Peter’s Abby Cook, and their competition kicks off in Belfast. A daily winner is declared at the end of each show, with scores building across the five days as the race to reveal the week's overall champion gets going.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Ben and Kate return to Longleat, where a lion needs surgery to amputate part of his tail. Kate gets a surprise with the eland babies, and Ben has a brush with a gorilla.

programme.title: Serengeti
programme.desc: There’s humour, heartbreak and nail-biting tension as our animal families face new tests and fresh rivalries. Soon a devastating storm creates the biggest problem of all.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show in which members of the public are invited to bring along their antiques for examination. At Renishaw Hall in Derbyshire, discoveries include a collection of swords, a homing pigeon clock, a patchwork quilt and a valuable painting of a lion.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This episode comes from the National Maritime Museum, Cornwall, based in Falmouth. Antiques expert Philip Serrell finds an unusual tortoise with an excellent pedigree and Caroline Hawley takes an electric guitar to auction which plucks at the heartstrings of the bidders. Presenter Paul Martin goes deep underground to uncover Cornwall's industrial past.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, former winners Edith Bowman, Rhys James, Anita Rani and Simon Rimmer take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall House of Champions winner being crowned on Friday. Will they opt for the House of Games golden cowboy hat, or instead go for the must-have golden wheelie luggage?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
programme.desc: Yorkshire couple Julie and Jason were happily married for 27 years. However, five years ago, Julie started going through perimenopause and menopause, which changed everything. She had no idea why she suddenly felt so different about the relationship. The couple began constantly fighting, and she even left her husband on several occasions. Now she is getting the correct medical treatment for her symptoms, it’s time to repair the hurt caused by five years of hostility and unkindness. The couple take on a problem-solving challenge to see how they work together, before Bear sets them a rescue mission - to keep an ember alight while gathering fuel for a signal fire. Relationship therapist Simone talks to them about the hurt they have experienced and encourages them to rekindle the spark they once shared. Can they break the negative patterns they have fallen into? Or is it too late to undo the damage?

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. On this episode, Aleem Maqbool reports from Cape Coast, Ghana, on the country's efforts to spearhead a global campaign for reparations from nations and institutions that profited from the transatlantic slave trade. And BBC Eye has exclusive access to Interpol officers as they target human trafficking networks in West Africa and help a father search for his missing children.‌

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Clive Myrie presents another heat of the classic quiz, where contenders take on the famous black chair under the glare of the spotlight and the ticking clock in an attempt to become the next Mastermind champion. The specialist subjects are Iron Maiden, Transport for London moquette, the films of Paul Newman and the Tintin books of Hergé.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. A high-scoring game, but since nobody goes home tonight, you could say it’s just for fun. And if your idea of fun is questions such as: what connects Gladiator Kim Betts, David Bowie, Pikachu and The Flash, then you’ve definitely come to the right place.

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: Teams from Bath and City St George’s University play their first game in the competition. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

programme.title: Buried with Michael Sheen
programme.desc: For years, Welsh actor Michael Sheen has been haunted by a story he discovered online about little-known farming consultant Douglas Gowan, who claimed the people of Wales had been poisoned by decades of toxic chemical dumping of polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) - a known class 1 carcinogen often called the 'godfather of forever chemicals'. Unable to let the story go, Michael follows a toxic trail that leads him to ask: who’s in danger now?

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob set off in a punt to fish for perch on a weir pool on the River Thames - leaving poor old terrier Ted forlorn on the river bank, as he is not allowed on the boat with them. They discuss the treats we give ourselves in life, however simple they may be. The trio are also joined by comedian Richard Herring for a heart healthy meal.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the crucial news stories of the day. With Faisal Islam.

programme.title: Disclosure
programme.desc: Disclosure investigates claims that parts of Scotland’s biggest city have become a 'no-go zone' because of crime, homelessness and antisocial behaviour. As thousands of tourists arrive in Glasgow for the summer, Myles Bonnar spends a week in the city centre exploring what might await them as they step off the train. Has disorder in the city become worse, or is tension simply being stoked online by those who trace every problem back to immigration?

programme.title: A House Through Time
programme.desc: The house's first residents are the Rev William Fitzsimmons, an 18th-century Episcopal Church minister who is arrested for helping French prisoners escape from Edinburgh Castle; Francis and Isabella Ronaldson, the former a post office worker who spied on Glasgow weavers to detect signs of radicalism; and the Steell family, including John, a skilled craftsman but terrible businessman, and his son John Steell Junior, who became one of Edinburgh's finest sculptors.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Die Leibwache steht bereit, als eine neue Gruppe Kandidaten versucht, die Burg zu stürmen. Zuvor müssen sie allerdings die Bienenwabe und das Sumoringen überstehen. Wer schafft es zum finalen Angriff? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während der General erneut hundert Kandidaten versammelt, die den Felsenkanal, das Frühstück und die Fallgrube überwinden müssen, bevor sie die Burg von Takeshi stürmen können. Hat einer von ihnen das Zeug dazu?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: 100 Kandidaten müssen das Wasser (und die Piraten) des Schildkrötenwegs überwinden, bevor sie sich dem Tauziehen im Schlamm stellen, um die Burg stürmen zu können. Der General sieht zu. Wird einer es schaffen? Kommentiert von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, wie neue Kandidaten versuchen, die Burg zu stürmen. Doch schaffen sie es angesichts der Dämonen, die in der Fallgrube warten? Vor dem Sieg müssen die Konkurrenz, die Aufgaben und die Leibgarde überwunden werden.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Es ist schmutzig, es ist verrückt, es ist Takeshi's Castle. 100 neue Teilnehmer müssen sich der fliegenden Klette und dem Torwandrennen stellen, bevor sie die Fallgrube überwinden und die Burg angreifen können. Russell Kane kommentiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, wie hundert mutige Kandidaten antreten, um Takeshis Burg zu stürmen. Zuerst müssen sie aber Wasser, Schlamm und viele andere unschöne Dinge überwinden. Nur die Stärksten können es schaffen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert Kandidaten stehen bereit, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Sie müssen das turbulente Tauziehen überstehen und beweisen, dass sie das Zeug dazu haben, die Leibgarde zu besiegen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand

programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services. At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Policy push brings smart homes into everyday life
programme.desc: China has expanded and upgraded its dual-new policy package, marking the first-ever inclusion of smart home products in central government consumption subsidies. CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores the Beijing Premium Housing Tech Expo, testing out smart home systems with voice control and automatic sensory adjustment. She also visits offline Suning stores, speaking with outlet managers and customers to uncover how smart home solutions are gaining mainstream traction, entering ordinary households, and driving the upgrade of China’s manufacturing industry.

programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services. At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. Join us on BizTalk for insights from UN Tourism and China Agricultural University as we explore China’s rural tourism model, the strong recovery in inbound travel and the next phase of growth for the country’s tourism industry.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the "dos and don'ts."

programme.title: Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum-0
programme.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the "dos and don'ts."

programme.title: Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum-0
programme.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing
programme.desc: Exploring the Folklore of Chongqing delves into the historical origins and cultural background of Fengdu Ghost City, and also features the Zhongyuan Festival celebrations and ancestor-worshipping rituals held here. These activities reflect the local people’s positive and optimistic outlook on life and death, as well as the great importance they attach to their ancestors, families and family traditions.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Alana : Déesse de Justice
programme.desc: Séparée de ses parents à la naissance, Alana grandit dans une société corrompue. Sujette à d’étranges colères, elle découvre qu’elle est la réincarnation de Sri Asih, déesse de justice. Ses pouvoirs vont bientôt changer le cours des choses.

programme.title: Baron rouge
programme.desc: Allemagne - Première Guerre mondiale. Le jeune pilote Manfred von Richthofen, alias Le Baron Rouge, est une célébrité au sein de l'armée de l'air allemande. Sa passion pour l'aviation lui ferait presque oublier que la guerre bat son plein en Europe…

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Une invention biochimique permet de sauver la fille de Lin Dong. Mais elle est convoitée par un mystérieux groupe criminel. Lin Dong va tout faire pour la protéger des criminels qui la traque.

programme.title: Tireur D'elite
programme.desc: 1915, en Lettonie. Après la mort de sa mère, le jeune Arturs rejoint avec son père et son frère les tirailleurs lettons. Confronté à l’horreur de la guerre et au deuil, il vit les tourments d’une nation déchirée entre Tsar et Kaiser.

programme.title: Winter in Wartime
programme.desc: Pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale un adolescent de 13 ans porte secours à un soldat anglais blessé.

programme.title: Borrego
programme.desc: Après avoir été témoin du crash de l'avion d'une mule dans le désert de Borrego, Elly est kidnappée et obligée de faire un dangereux voyage vers un point de chute éloigné.

programme.title: Hombres de élite
programme.desc: En este tenso thriller protagonizado por John Travolta y Kate Bosworth, un equipo de trabajadores de líneas eléctricas de Texas se apresura a instalar kilómetros de cable antes de que una mortal tormenta eléctrica destruya la red eléctrica.

programme.title: Justa venganza
programme.desc: Después de que su esposa es brutalmente asesinada, el exmafioso Ben Archer libra la guerra contra las tríadas chinas. Protagonizada por la leyenda de acción Jean-Claude Van Damme.

programme.title: Perdido en la fama
programme.desc: Un rockero semi retirado y caprichoso (Antonio Banderas) debe espabilarse para rescatar a su esposa, quien ha sido secuestrada mientras se encontraba de vacaciones en Chile.

programme.title: Ronin (ESP)
programme.desc: Un equipo de agentes especiales internacionales debe llevar a cabo una misión misteriosa: robar un maletín fuertemente custodiado buscado tanto por el IRA como por la mafia rusa.

programme.title: Asesinato justo
programme.desc: Dos detectives veteranos de la ciudad de Nueva York (ganadores del Premio de la Academia® Robert De Niro y Al Pacino) buscan a un justiciero que puede ser uno de los suyos.

programme.title: Cuenta final
programme.desc: Nick Wells, es un veterano ladrón, decidido reivindicarse, vivir con su novia y poner un club de jazz. Pero su amigo Max, le propone un último trabajo que lo hará pasar por imprevistos y traiciones.

programme.title: El cuerpo del delito
programme.desc: Tras una noche de pasión desenfrenada, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) será juzgada por asesinato. Ahora está en manos de su abogado (Willem Dafoe) demostrar su inocencia, aunque el camino hacia la verdad tiene tantas curvas como su seductora cliente.

programme.title: Un despertar glorioso
programme.desc: Un presentador de la vieja escuela renuncia a su programa de noticias de mucho tiempo debido a las costumbres nuevas. Es reclutado por un productor estrella que quiere revivir un programa matutino endeble.

programme.title: El curioso caso de Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt y Cate Blanchett protagonizan esta adaptación de la historia de F. Scott Fitzgerald acerca de un anciano que va rejuveneciendo y los problemas que surgen cuando se enamora de una mujer.

programme.title: Cómo perder a un hombre en 10 días.
programme.desc: Una columnista acepta escribir, desde su propia experiencia, cómo lograr que un hombre se aleje de tu vida en solo 10 días.

programme.title: Fiebre Del Sabado Por La Noche
programme.desc: Protagonizado por John Travolta como Tony Manero, un talentoso bailarín de Brooklyn que busca escapar de su vida rutinaria a través de la música disco y las competiciones de baile, mientras enfrenta conflictos personales y familiares.

programme.title: Adventureland
programme.desc: Quand James doit annuler ses vacances d'été de rêve pour économiser pour ses études, le seul emploi qu'il peut obtenir est celui à Adventureland, un parc d'attractions de pacotille où les jeux sont truqués et les manèges font vomir.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, Aeon Flux des Monicans doit tuer un dirigeant de Bregna, dernier bastion humain, dirigé par des scientifiques.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: L'existence de Lester est loin d'être parfaite. Il change quelques choses, devient plus libre, plus heureux. Mais Lester va bientôt apprendre que la liberté totale a un prix.

programme.title: American Gigolo
programme.desc: Julian Kay a tout pour plaire : la Mercedes, les vêtements, l'accès aux établissements les plus chics de Beverly Hills et une écurie de riches clientes. Mais tout s'effondre après qu'il a rendu service à son ancien proxénète.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d’arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c’est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: A Better Life
programme.desc: Un ouvrier mexicain, immigré installé à Los Angeles, va tout tenter pour protéger son fils.

programme.title: Mega Shark versus Crocosaurus
programme.desc: L’énorme requin préhistorique a survécu à la dernière bataille, mais le monde tremble à nouveau quand un rival encore plus dangereux fait son apparition en Afrique.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Alors que l’ouragan Katrina frappe la Nouvelle-Orléans, un jeune père doit lutter pour la survie de son bébé prématuré dans un hôpital déserté de tous… ou presque.

programme.title: Haemoo
programme.desc: Capitaine d’un bateau de pêche menacé d’être vendu par son propriétaire, Kang décide de racheter lui-même le navire pour sauvegarder son poste et son équipage. Mais la pêche est insuffisante, et l’argent vient à manquer.

programme.title: Seuls sur Terre
programme.desc: Del pense être le dernier homme sur Terre suite à une catastrophe qui a décimé l'humanité. Mais son isolement est contrarié par l'arrivée d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Alerte Tsunamis
programme.desc: Le premier frappe sans prévenir. Puis un autre. Bientôt, les énormes murs d’eau engloutissent côte après côte, ville après ville. Alors que d’innombrables vies sont perdues dans l’assaut, le pire reste à venir.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Un building de 50 étages. Une simple négligence. Des milliers de personnes prises aux pièges par l'incendie le plus dévastateur de la décennie. Seul rempart contre les flammes, une escouade de soldats du feu surentrainée et prête à tout pour intervenir.

programme.title: Catastrophe en plein ciel
programme.desc: Une éruption solaire provoque la mort d'un pilote d'avion, plongeant les passagers dans un danger de mort immédiat.

programme.title: La Marque du Dragon
programme.desc: Un mystérieux hôtelier cache un passé trouble alors que des voyageurs commencent à disparaître un à un.

programme.title: Chinese Widow
programme.desc: En 1941, après Pearl Harbor, le Raid Doolittle vise Tokyo avec des B-25 mal adaptés pour un retour sur porte-avions. Le capitaine Jack Turner s’écrase en Chine et, aidé par la résistante Ying, tente de survivre et d’échapper aux forces japonaises.

programme.title: Undercover Punch and Gun
programme.desc: Wu, policier infiltré au sein d’un réseau de méthamphétamine, doit s'associer à une bande hétéroclite pour faire tomber un énorme trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Une Pluie Sans Fin
programme.desc: 1997. À quelques mois de la rétrocession de Hong-Kong, la Chine va vivre de grands changements… Yu Guowei, le chef de la sécurité d’une vieille usine, dans le Sud du pays, enquête sur une série de meurtres commis sur des jeunes femmes.

programme.title: Code 252: Signal de détresse
programme.desc: Suite à un tremblement de terre survenu à Tokyo, la température de l'Océan Pacifique grimpe dangereusement. Une tempête impressionnante, puis un tsunami s'abattent sur la ville. Des survivants vont tenter de transmettre le code 252, synonyme de secours.

programme.title: The Great Battle
programme.desc: En 645, l’Empereur Li de la Dynastie Tang envahit Goguryeo. Face à l’armée massive assiégeant la forteresse d’Ansi, le Général Yang, isolé et surpassé, rassemble ses troupes et se prépare à une résistance héroïque.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: John Cusack interprète un agent des renseignements américains qui retourne à Shanghai fin 1941 pour enquêter sur la mort de son ami, et trouve sur son chemin l’amour et une conspiration bien plus vaste.

programme.title: Ciné d'horreur by Pluto TV
programme.desc: Tremblez de peur tout au long du mois d'octobre sur Pluto TV Horreur avec une programmation spéciale dédiée aux âmes les plus courageuses. Des classiques cultes aux nouveautés les plus terrifiantes, préparez-vous à une expérience horrifique inoubliable

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire en vacances fait appel à la justice pour récupérer son enfant enlevé.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille sur une île où elles sont pourchassées.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Bit
programme.desc: Une adolescente transgenre en vacances d'été à Los Angeles se bat pour survivre après être tombée sur quatre vampires féministes queer, qui tentent de débarrasser les rues de la ville des hommes prédateurs.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l’ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu’ils ignorent, c’est qu’ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L’ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Le Dernier Tueur à Gage
programme.desc: Harry, un tueur à gages vieillissant, vient de faire échouer une mission et est maintenant la cible. Sa fille, qui travaille également comme tueuse à gages, est elle aussi prise pour cible. Un jeune tueur à gages, Billy, est envoyé pour éliminer Harry, mais ils forment une alliance difficile...

programme.title: Every Last One of Them
programme.desc: Un homme est à la recherche de sa fille disparue, mais sa recherche révèle un complot plus vaste impliquant un gros accord capitaliste qui fait dérailler Chinatown sur les droits de l'eau.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Un détective de police suit une piste d'indices qui semble finalement mener au frère ex-détenu de son partenaire de confiance, qu'il a aidé à mettre en prison il y a des années.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s’est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l’arrestation d’un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l’élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c’est l’occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l’exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu’il mérite toujours son titre d’homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu’il n’a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Zombeavers
programme.desc: Un groupe d’adolescents en vacances au bord d’une rivière se retrouve menacé par une horde de castors zombies. Le weekend de débauche va rapidement tourner à la catastrophe pour les jeunes. Pour rester en vie ils vont devoir se confronter aux castors zombies qui les attaquent dans leurs propres cabines...

programme.title: Kickboxer 5: Le Dernier Combat
programme.desc: Pour monter sa propre fédération de Kickboxing, l'organisation Mygale a recours à des méthodes radicales : les champions qui refusent ses offres sont purement et simplement éliminés. Matt Reeves part en Afrique du Sud pour une compétition interdite de Kickboxing sans règlement

programme.title: Un asesino anda suelto
programme.desc: Un asesino en serie está suelto y ha secuestrado al hijo de un agente del FBI que lo persigue. Pero, ¿quién es el asesino? Una historia llena de emociones y sorpresas.

programme.title: Una vida mejor
programme.desc: Carlos Galindo, un jardinero mexicano en California, lucha por alejar a su hijo Luis de las pandillas. Tras el robo de su camioneta, la logran recuperar, pero la policía descubre que es indocumentado, poniendo en riesgo su futuro y su relación.

programme.title: Días de trueno

From the scorching sand dunes of Namibia, to the tropical Tasmanian rainforest, to the bitter waters of the Baltic Sea, this film visits the most extraordinary ecosystems and the creatures that inhabit them. programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Irrawaddy Delta: The Magical World of Mangroves
programme.desc: The Irrawaddy Delta in southern Myanmar is home to the most diverse mangrove forests in the world. The forests serve as natural protection against cyclones that regularly strike the region. The Irrawaddy's widely branching tributaries not only provide schools of fish and rich nutrients, but also function as the most important transport route for the people living in the delta. The greengrocer couple U Tin Hlaing and Daw Khin Lay supply the villages downstream with their fresh produce. But they do not go any further than the Meinmahla Kyun Wildlife Sanctuary. From that point on, the river becomes increasingly turbulent, too dangerous for their small, flat boat. The sanctuary is home to a variety of animal species including the rare Irrawaddy dolphins, saltwater crocodiles, birds of prey such as black kites and brahminy kites, migratory birds such as spoon-billed sandpipers, woodcocks, great cormorants and various anatids. Ranger Lha Soe Win and his colleagues regularly patrol the nature reserve to monitor the animal population and make sure the mangroves are no longer illegally logged for firewood. Since the 1970s, the mangrove population has declined by more than 60 percent, with dramatic consequences for the inhabitants of the delta. Cyclone Nargis, the most devastating cyclone to date, claimed the lives of around 130,000 Burmese in 2008. Together with scientists from the conservation charity Flora and Fauna International, the rangers are working on reforesting the mangroves to restore their function as a natural barrier in the future.

Crímenes imperfectos: Enamorado mortal
programme.desc: Un obstetra regresó a casa del hospital y encontró a su esposa en el piso del baño. Estaba cubierta de sangre y no respiraba.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1992, Dawn Bruce, de 22 años, es brutalmente asesinada en su apartamento de Virginia. Los investigadores notan una mancha de sangre en la funda de una almohada que parece haber sido hecha por uno de los dedos del asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una bomba, construida para poder causar tanto daño como sea posible, mata a la víctima con una fuerza y llama mortal.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: La pista ardiente
programme.desc: Un pirómano en serie anda suelto en Washington, DC. Cada uno de los incendios se inició con el mismo tipo de dispositivo incendiario.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Fiebre del oro
programme.desc: El despacho de emergencia recibió una llamada de un hombre que dijo que su novia se disparó y se suicidó. La autopsia reveló que la herida de bala no fue autoinfligida.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Esta examinación del papel que juegan las autopsias en las investigaciones de asesinatos se centra en la sospechosa muerte de Virginia Ridley.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2003, Tiffany Rowell y tres de sus amigas fueron brutalmente asesinadas en la adinerada área de Clear Lake, Texas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de una mujer joven fue descubierto en una granja aislada cerca de Delano, California. Ella no tenía identificación, pero la policía encontró las llaves de un buzón de correo en los bolsillos de sus pantalones.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1990, el cuerpo de Shirley Andronowich fue encontrado mutilado. Los testigos le dijeron a la policía que tuvo una pelea con su esposo la noche anterior, pero la evidencia forense demostró que él no tuvo nada que ver con su muerte.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un tiroteo desde un vehículo deja un hombre muerto y otro gravemente herido. Las llamadas de teléfonos celulares y los casquillos de bala apuntan a un sospechoso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Rompiendo el Molde
programme.desc: El hijo de tres años de unos padres de Dripping Springs, Texas, desarrolla una condición respiratoria.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Edward Honaker fue declarado culpable de violación, sodomía y agresión sexual agraviada y condenado a tres cadenas perpetuas en prisión. El sostuvo su inocencia.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Ellos pensaron que el incendio cubriría su crimen. Pero una pequeña pista, no más grande que una tachuela, permaneció allí. Contenía toda la información que los investigadores necesitaban para poner a un trío de asesinos a sangre fría tras las rejas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Pensamientos privados
programme.desc: Cuando los bomberos encontraron a una familia entera muerta dentro de su casa, parecía un asesinato-suicidio, pero había varias pistas inconsistentes entre los escombros.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La escena del crimen estaba inundada de sangre, lo que hablaba del horror del crimen: el asesinato de dos niños pequeños y el apuñalamiento de su madre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los excursionistas cerca de Anchorage, Alaska, descubrieron un cuerpo envuelto en sábanas con bordes de costura naranja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Ahogamiento seco
programme.desc: Cuando Genell Plude es encontrada muerta en su baño, la escena apunta a un suicidio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un violador en serie anda suelto en una ciudad de Texas. Nadie sabía dónde atacaría a continuación, pero la audacia de sus ataques y la escalada de violencia contra sus víctimas hicieron que encontrarlo fuera imperativo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, más de una docena de niños en Seattle, Washington, luchaban por sus vidas. Cada uno de ellos había contraído una enfermedad grave desconocida. Después de que uno murió, los investigadores sabían que el reloj estaba corriendo.

programme.title: فيوجيتيف هانترز: ميكسكو
programme.desc: يقوم فريق فيوجتيف هانترز بالتخفي في صالة رياضية للقبض على أمريكي هارب مطلوب بتهمة القتل في كاليفورنيا. ثم يتنكر العملاء كسيّاح في بلدة ساحلية للعثور على فار من سان دييغو مطلوب بتهمة الاتجار بالمخدرات.

programme.title: إنتروغيشن كام
programme.desc: يفقد مشتبه به أعصابه داخل غرفة التحقيق، ويترك رجل مصاب بجرح ناجم عن طلق ناري مروع رجال الشرطة أمام أسئلة أكثر من الإجابات، تتحول لعبة الغميضة إلى كارثة، والمزيد.

programme.title: إنتروغيشن كام
programme.desc: يتم استجواب عارضة أزياء عن لقاء مميت مع حبيبها، يقوم رجل بتقديم اعتراف بدم بارد، يتفوه رجل متهم بجريمة بما هو أكثر من اللازم، والمزيد.

programme.title: دونت أوبن ذا دور
programme.desc: في بلدة شاطئية في كاليفورنيا، يتخذ راكب الأمواج والعملاق التجاري كريس سميث قراراً مفاجئاً بالخروج من عمله الناجح في مجال التسويق، ويغادر على متن يخت مستأجر ليبحر حول العالم مع إحدى نجمات مجلة بلاي بوي. أو على الأقل هذا ما تذكره رسائله الإلكترونية.

programme.title: ميردر أت ذا موتيل
programme.desc: يستجيب عناصر من قسم شريف مقاطعة ريفرسايد لبلاغ عن موقع سيارة مهجورة في منطقة نائية في تلال غافيلان. يصاب المحققون بالصدمة عند اكتشاف جثتي رجلين مقتولين بوحشية داخل صندوق السيارة.

programme.title: امبرفيكت ميردر
programme.desc: وقعت جريمة قتل كاري فارفر وسط شبكة معقدة من الغيرة والهوس في علاقاتها مع ديفيد كروبا وشانا ليز غوليار. اختفت كاري بشكل غامض بعد مغادرتها شقة ديفيد، مما أثار سلسلة من الرسائل النصية المشبوهة.

programme.title: كورت كام
programme.desc: نظرة على بعض من أكثر اللحظات جنونًا في قاعة المحكمة. يكون أحد القضاة غير سعيد بملابس أحد المتهمين غير اللائقة في المحكمة؛ يندلع شجار في قاعة المحكمة خلال مرحلة النطق بالحكم في محاكمة، كما يوبخ القاضي المتهمة لانتهاكها شروط الكفالة؛ وأكثر من ذلك.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: سرعان ما تربط الشرطة في جاسبر، تكساس بين تقرير لشخص مفقود وشاحنة مهجورة. ويكون البحث جاري عن مارتن بايرلي، البالغ من العمر 58 عامًا، وهو ميكانيكي مجتهد معروف بشرب الكحول ومصاحبة النساء وحمل كمية كبيرة من النقود.

programme.title: امبرفيكت ميردر
programme.desc: وقعت جريمة قتل كاري فارفر وسط شبكة معقدة من الغيرة والهوس في علاقاتها مع ديفيد كروبا وشانا ليز غوليار. اختفت كاري بشكل غامض بعد مغادرتها شقة ديفيد، مما أثار سلسلة من الرسائل النصية المشبوهة.

programme.title: افتر ذا فيرست 48
programme.desc: عندما يُقتل شقيقان محبوبان بالرصاص داخل منزلهما، تقود والدتهما المكلومة محققي "غوينيت" إلى مشتبه به من الدائرة المقربة؛ غير أن غياب دافع واضح لتعزيز قضيتهم قد يضع المدعين العامين في مأزق أثناء المحاكمة.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: مسلح يقتل عضو العصابة السابق آرون إيتورا أثناء نومه. في نهاية المطاف، يجمع محققو أوريغون الرابط بين مكالمة هاتفية غامضة وناشط محلي مناهض للعصابات وعلبة سجائر مسروقة.

programme.title: غرين آيد كيليرز
programme.desc: اكتشف تفاصيل جريمة القتل المروعة للشاب إيثان بوسورث البالغ من العمر 20 عامًا، وهو شاب محبوب انتهت حياته بشكل مأساوي على يد كاميرون كيم البالغ من العمر 17 عامًا. إنها قصة عن الغيرة والغضب والعواقب المدمرة للهوس غير المتحكم فيه.

programme.title: موتيف تو ميردر
programme.desc: استكشف الأبعاد النفسية لبعض قضايا القتل الحقيقية التي استحوذت على اهتمام العالم.

programme.title: ماي ستراينج أراست
programme.desc: نظرة على بعض أغرب الاعتقالات في مختلف أنحاء البلاد. رجل عارٍ يزعم أنه سرق مركبة رباعية الدفع؛ رجل كان على ما يبدو يطعم التماسيح يتلقى زيارة من الشرطة.

programme.title: أوزارك لو
programme.desc: تتوافد الحشود إلى بحيرة الأوزاركس لحضور مهرجان أكوابالوزا الموسيقي السنوي في الصيف خلال النهار، لذا يواجه المحقق الرقيب مارك كوردولا والرئيس بورين مجموعة من الشبان القاصرين الذين يتوافدون إلى الحانات باستخدام بطاقات هوية مزورة خلال الليل.

programme.title: ميردر باي ميدك
programme.desc: يشهد مستشفى صغير في تشيليكوث، أوهايو، 18 حالة طوارئ "كود بلو" وتسع وفيات مشبوهة، مما يؤدي إلى تحقيق جنائي استمر لعقود.

programme.title: ميردر باي ميدك
programme.desc: تدفع تشارلي داراغ والدتها لتقديم شكوى حول تعامل إحدى الممرضات في دار الرعاية، دون أن تتخيل بأن هذا سيؤدي إلى وفاة والدتها.

programme.title: ميردر أت ذا موتيل
programme.desc: يتم استدعاء الشرطة إلى نُزل نيو فولز بعد تلقيهم مكالمة حول امرأة فاقدة للوعي. وبعد وصولهم، يتجاهل الضباط سريعاً الرواية التي تقول إنها تعرضت لأزمة قلبية عندما شاهدوا مدى خطورة إصاباتها.

programme.title: غرين آيد كيليرز
programme.desc: كانت ياردلي لوف طالبة تبلغ من العمر 22 عامًا تدرس العلوم السياسية وكان أمامها مستقبل واعد حتى أجهزت عليها حادثة عنف واحدة وسلبت منها حياتها، تاركةً مجتمع جامعة فيرجينيا في حالة صدمة.

programme.title: سانشاين سلاينغس
programme.desc: عندما تختفي سائحة يابانية في نيو أورلينز، تسارع الشرطة لتحديد هوية الرجال الذين تظهر صورهم على كاميرتها الرقمية.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: أدى اتصال غريب برقم الطوارئ 911 إلى وصول الشرطة إلى مسرح جريمة قتل بشعة، راح ضحيتها باتريك مكراي البالغ من العمر 43 عامًا. عُثر عليه ميتًا في منزله، مصابًا بجروح طعن عنيفة في رقبته وكتفيه.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: في ليلة دافئة من شهر سبتمبر عام 2005، تختفي جينيفر تيغ، الرياضية الشهيرة في مدرستها الثانوية، بشكل غامض أثناء عودتها إلى المنزل سيراً على الأقدام بعد انتهاء عملها الليلي. وبعد عشرة أيام، يتم العثور على جثتها في المستنقع.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: بعد اختفاء فنان الوشم آدم يونغ البالغ من العمر 35 عامًا، كان الدليل الوحيد على مكان وجوده هو فيديو مراقبة له في 20 نوفمبر 2017، وهو يخرج من مبنى شقته في وسط مدينة كالجاري مع ما يبدو أنه اثنان من أصدقائه.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: كانت كاسي سيشوك، البالغة من العمر 22 عام، تحاول فقط إعادة حياتها إلى المسار الصحيح بعد معاناة من مأساة مؤلمة، عندما تختفي دون أثر. وآخر مكان شوهدت فيه كان دخولها إلى حفلة في شقة وسط المدينة في نياجرا.

programme.title: سامباديز هايدنغ سامثنغ
programme.desc: بعد يومين من إبلاغ ميشيل جورج الشرطة عن اختفاء خطيبها السابق جيمس إل. والش، عثرت الشرطة على جثته المتحللة في مؤخرة شاحنة توصيل. من الواضح أنها جريمة قتل، لكن سبب الوفاة لا يزال مجهولاً.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her own flesh and blood.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Obsession
programme.desc: Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune hunters.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Chronik des Dritten Reichs
programme.desc: 1933-1935: Gleichschaltung - Am 30. Januar 1933 wurde Adolf Hitler zum Reichskanzler ernannt. Die Macht über Deutschland einmal in den Händen, ließen die Nazis sie nicht mehr los - bis zum Untergang am 8. Mai 1945. Es begann mit großen Hoffnungen und beispiellosem Jubel - und endete nach einem Weltkrieg mit mehr als 50 Millionen Toten, der Zerstörung Deutschlands und dem Völkermord an den europäischen Juden.

programme.title: Chronik des Dritten Reichs
programme.desc: 1936-1939: Der Weg zum Krieg - Deutschlands Rohstoffknappheit wird immer offensichtlicher, das Land steht kurz vor der Insolvenz, auch wenn es nach außen hin nach einem Wirtschaftsaufschwung aussieht. Doch außenpolitische Erfolge lenken von den innenpolitischen Problemen ab: Deutsche Soldaten kämpfen im Spanischen Bürgerkrieg mit, marschieren in Österreich ein und besetzen im März 1939 die Slowakei. Der 2. Weltkrieg steht vor der Tür.

programme.title: Chronik des Dritten Reichs
programme.desc: 1939-1942: Krieg und Vernichtung - Von 1939 bis 1941 ist Fortuna aufseiten der deutschen Truppen, ob Polen, Frankreich, Baltikum, Weißrussland oder Ukraine: Die Taktik der Blitzkriege scheint erfolgreich. Doch kurz vor Moskau kommt der deutsche Angriff ins Stocken. Die Niederlage bei Stalingrad markiert die Wende zugunsten der Alliierten. Währenddessen läuft die Vernichtung der jüdischen Bevölkerung auf Hochtouren.
